title: Inorder Successor in BST II
goal: Find the inorder successor of a BST node using its child and parent links.
strategy: If a right subtree exists, its leftmost node is next. Otherwise climb past ancestors reached from their right child; the first ancestor reached from its left child is the next larger node.
